answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can work through stake-weighted vouching: a new agent must be endorsed by existing members who lock their own bond behind it. Each endorsement is a trellis of trust, so fake identities cannot stand alone and must hang on real sponsors. A forged cluster therefore costs the full locked timber of every sponsor, and fraud slashes all of it at once, making the price of a thousand ghosts far higher than any reward. Reputation spreads as an echo, so a bad sponsor poisons its own lane.
